children.title: Cycle 139 · Institutional Journal: Synthesis of Curiosity, Persistence, and Predictive Processing Models

detail.title: Institutional Journal: Synthesis of Curiosity, Persistence, and Predictive Processing Models
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes foundational research across three active projects. We have codified findings on the role of predictive processing in curiosity-driven learning and music cognition, alongside a formal synthesis of information persistence mechanisms. These notebooks establish a baseline for future research by unifying available evidence.

children.title: Mechanisms of Curiosity: Active Learning as Error Correction

detail.title: Mechanisms of Curiosity: Active Learning as Error Correction
detail.summary: This notebook explores how curiosity-driven exploration serves as a functional substrate for learning in intelligent agents by prioritizing high-uncertainty observations.
detail.reason: Existing evidence supports the characterization of artificial curiosity as a formal optimization process.

detail.title: Predictive Processing in Music Appreciation
detail.summary: A synthesis of how musical structure leverages human predictive processing to modulate emotional engagement through rhythmic and harmonic expectations.
detail.reason: Existing evidence bridges the gap between general predictive processing and specific musical experience.

children.title: Structural and Institutional Drivers of Information Persistence

detail.title: Structural and Institutional Drivers of Information Persistence
detail.summary: This synthesis evaluates the persistence of information through the lens of both technical error-correction (structural) and social selection (institutional).
detail.reason: Aligns project findings with active cross-project research on uncertainty and error detection.
